summary: Classic Buzz stereo cross-feedback delay: mono in, a left and a right line whose feedback crosses over, per track. For ping-pong and wide echoes.
quirks: Mono in, stereo out: the left line's echo feeds the right line and the other way round, so different lengths ping-pong.
Each track is its own pair of lines with its own lengths, feedback and level (8 at most).
Lengths count in Length unit, ticks by default.
ReBuzz feeds it left + right summed, so a centred signal comes out about 6 dB louder with Dry thru on (profile: +6.1 dB).
evidence: ExternalMachines/source/buzztrax-buzzmachines/Jeskola/CrossDelay/CrossDelay.cpp — parameters, DescribeValue, cross feedback in DoWork
ReBuzz/NativeMachine/NativeMessage.cs — a mono native effect gets left + right summed
